en.joke: My screen time report is basically a memoir of my poor life choices.
en.explanation: It's funny because it uses the formal term "memoir" to ironically describe the embarrassing reality of excessive digital consumption, a common modern experience.

people.name: Andi Peters
people.extract: Andi Eleazu Peters is a British television presenter, producer, journalist and voice actor, currently employed by ITV and known for presenting Children's BBC, roles on breakfast TV shows Live & Kicking, GMTV, Good Morning Britain and Lorraine, and for hosting Dancing on Ice: Extra and The Big Reunion.
highlights: Known for Live & Kicking, GMTV, Good Morning Britain.
Hosted Dancing on Ice: Extra and The Big Reunion.

people.name: Patti Scialfa
people.extract: Vivienne Patricia Scialfa is an American singer-songwriter and guitarist. Scialfa has been a member of the E Street Band since 1984 and has been married to Bruce Springsteen since 1991. In 2014, Scialfa was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame as a member of the E Street Band.
highlights: Member of the E Street Band since 1984.
Inducted into Rock and Roll Hall of Fame.

people.name: Maria Ouspenskaya
people.extract: Maria Alekseyevna Ouspenskaya was a Russian actress and acting teacher. She achieved success as a stage actress as a young woman in Russia, and as an older woman in Hollywood films. She was twice nominated for the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress for Dodsworth (1936) and Love Affair (1939). Ouspenskaya is the first Russian actress to be nominated for an Oscar.
highlights: Twice nominated for Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress.
Nominated for Dodsworth (1936) and Love Affair (1939).
First Russian actress nominated for an Oscar.
